security_audit.summary: All 33 static alerts are false positives caused by Markdown formatting, local examples, or ordinary backend terminology. Two medium semantic issues remain in the sample guidance: exception details may reach clients, and cryptographic advice is ambiguous. No prompt injection or malicious intent was found.

remediation.issue: The FastAPI exception handler returns the raw exception text to clients.
remediation.suggestion: Return a generic client message, log detailed errors internally, and attach only a trace identifier to the response.

remediation.issue: The sensitive-field guidance treats AES-256 and bcrypt as interchangeable encryption options.
remediation.suggestion: Separate password hashing from field encryption, and specify authenticated encryption, secure key storage, and key rotation.

semantic_findings.title: Raw Exception Details Returned to Clients
semantic_findings.description: The FastAPI example converts exceptions to response text, which can expose internal paths, database details, or sensitive operational context.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The example directly assigns str(exc) to a client-visible message. Raw exception disclosure is a well-established information exposure risk.

semantic_findings.title: Ambiguous Sensitive-Field Cryptography Guidance
semantic_findings.description: The guidance presents AES-256 and bcrypt as encryption alternatives, although bcrypt is irreversible and AES security depends on mode and key handling.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: Line 56 explicitly groups AES-256 and bcrypt under sensitive-field encryption. The recommendation can lead to incorrect protection choices.

content.user_title: Build Secure and Reliable Backend Services
content.value_statement: Backend work requires coordinated decisions across APIs, databases, security, performance, and operations. This skill provides practical workflows, checklists, commands, and Python examples.
actual_capabilities: Structures backend projects and modules from requirements through deployment.
Guides API validation, error handling, tracing, and testing decisions.
Reviews database queries, indexes, migrations, transactions, and pagination.
Provides security and deployment checklists for production services.
Supports performance diagnosis with logs, query plans, profiling, and load tests.
Compares technology choices using maintainability, ecosystem, operations, and performance criteria.
limitations: It provides guidance and examples, but it does not supply a complete runnable application.
Commands and configuration examples require adaptation to the target environment.
Architecture recommendations depend on workload, team skills, compliance needs, and existing systems.
The included Python snippets omit some production security and error-handling details.

use_cases.title: Design a New Service
use_cases.description: Turn product requirements into an API, data model, implementation plan, tests, and deployment checklist.
use_cases.target_user: Backend developers starting a service or module

use_cases.title: Review Production Readiness
use_cases.description: Evaluate validation, security, observability, database behavior, resilience, and deployment controls before release.

use_cases.title: Diagnose Service Performance
use_cases.description: Trace slow requests through application logs, database queries, external calls, memory profiles, and connection pools.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Backend Endpoint
prompt_templates.prompt: Design an endpoint for [feature]. Define requests, responses, validation, errors, persistence, authorization, and focused tests. Ask for missing requirements first.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner planning a single API feature

prompt_templates.title: Design a Data Model
prompt_templates.prompt: Model [domain] for [database]. Include entities, relationships, constraints, indexes, migration steps, rollback strategy, expected volume, and key query patterns.

prompt_templates.title: Review a Backend Change
prompt_templates.prompt: Review [change or files] for correctness, security, transactions, concurrency, query performance, error handling, observability, and missing tests. Rank findings by severity.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Production Migration
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a staged migration from [current system] to [target system]. Cover compatibility, data movement, rollout, monitoring, rollback, capacity, failure modes, and ownership.
prompt_templates.scenario: Architect coordinating a high-risk service migration

output_examples.input: Design a paginated order history endpoint for a mobile application.
output: Recommendation: use cursor pagination ordered by immutable order identifiers.
Define authenticated access, bounded page sizes, stable sorting, and opaque cursors.
Test ownership checks, malformed cursors, empty pages, concurrent inserts, and final-page behavior.

output_examples.input: Review a slow product search endpoint.
output: Start with request traces and database execution plans before adding cache infrastructure.
Check missing indexes, broad result sets, repeated relationship queries, and external dependency latency.
Measure improvements with representative data and a documented latency target.

output_examples.input: Prepare a backend service for deployment.
output: Verify secret handling, health probes, graceful shutdown, resource limits, connection pools, and backup ownership.
Add structured logs and trace identifiers without recording sensitive data.
Define rollout checks, alert thresholds, and a tested rollback procedure.

best_practices: Confirm business rules, data volume, concurrency, and deployment constraints before selecting an architecture.
Validate behavior with focused tests, query plans, representative load, and observable production signals.
Review every command, migration, and configuration change before applying it to a shared environment.
anti_patterns: Do not concatenate untrusted input into SQL, shell commands, URLs, or log messages.
Do not expose raw exceptions, secrets, credentials, or personal data in responses and logs.
Do not optimize with caches or indexes before measuring the actual bottleneck.

faq.question: Which backend frameworks does this skill support?
faq.answer: The workflow is framework-neutral, with examples using FastAPI and common Python patterns.

faq.question: Can it create a complete production service?
faq.answer: It can guide implementation, but production code still requires project-specific integration, testing, security review, and operational validation.

faq.question: Does it execute Docker or Kubernetes commands automatically?
faq.answer: No. The skill lists reference commands that users must review and run in the correct environment.

faq.question: Can it help optimize database performance?
faq.answer: Yes. It emphasizes query plans, indexing, pagination, connection pools, batching, and avoiding repeated relationship queries.

faq.question: Does it cover backend security?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers validation, parameterized queries, password hashing, secret handling, rate limits, CORS, dependency scanning, and sensitive logging.

faq.question: What information should I provide first?
faq.answer: Provide the language, framework, database, business rules, expected traffic, deployment target, constraints, and relevant project files.
